q: How long can the police hold an arrested person with legal residence in Denmark before the person must be brought before a judge?

options.t: Up to 1 døgn, one day and night

answerText: Up to 1 døgn, one day and night
appeared: It appeared in 4 different exams, most recently in June 2026.

da.q: Hvor længe kan politiet tilbageholde en anholdt person, der har lovligt ophold i Danmark, før personen skal stilles for en dommer?

learn.text: The police can under certain conditions arrest a person who is reasonably suspected of a punishable offence. If a citizen is arrested, they must be brought before a judge within 24 hours, one døgn.

q: What is the age of criminal responsibility in Denmark?
appeared: It appeared in 5 different exams, most recently in November 2025.

da.q: Hvad er den kriminelle lavalder i Danmark?

learn.text: In Denmark, the age of criminal responsibility is 15 years.

q: Who decides whether a citizen is to be remanded in custody?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2024 exam.

da.q: Hvem afgør, om en borger skal varetægtsfængsles?

learn.text: It is up to the judge to decide whether the citizen is to be released or remanded in custody while the police and the prosecution service investigate the case.
